name: Frost Titan
description: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: War Horn
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

abilities.name: Cleaving Strike
abilities.description: When a PC marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

abilities.name: Trophy Hunter
abilities.description: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC’s most valuable possession as a trophy.
